about.title: About
about.demo: Safe Dial is a phone app: contacts and call log are read directly from your phone, while the blacklist and stats are stored on the device.

privacyItems.q: What data does Safe Dial use?
privacyItems.a: Incoming phone numbers, the call log and contacts, to identify callers and apply block rules.
Settings, block list, marks and stats are stored on your device. The app doesn't send data anywhere.
No. Contacts are only used for caller identification. They are never sold or shared with third parties.

about.termsText: You use the app at your own responsibility. Warnings are based on your own blacklist and marks, so they are for reference only. Always be careful when giving personal information over the phone.
